impact_assessment.why: Planner returns any legal backend proposal forever; a stalled legal proposal truncates at 200/0, and the self-model outcome signal is not load-bearing.

impact_assessment.risks: contract: Planner gains trust_window and a model_decision probe; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: hub gains steps_since_reward, vectors unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extract rule action before decision; default window 20; disable via trust_window=None for raw floor control; all goldens and standing pins re-run; failing-first tests.
